lines.zh: 黑发垂在眼前，我拨了一下。
lines.en: Black hair hangs in my eyes; I push it aside.
I walk on ki and my feet never touch dirt.

lines.zh: 这一步跨得太大，我缩短些。
lines.en: That stride was too long; I shorten it.
My boots rasp through the grass.

lines.zh: 我顺着山脊走，风在下面。
lines.en: I follow the ridgeline with the wind below.
Shoulders loose, I'm in no hurry.
Step by step I make the path solid.
I duck the low branch.
My stomach's a bit empty, so my steps slow.
I tighten my wristbands as I walk.
I walk a long way along the stream.
One push off the ground and I slide far.
I stand still, breathing slowly.
I draw my ki down into my gut.
The wind blows and my black hair covers my eyes.
I hook my hands behind my belt.
I'm wondering if this fight is worth it.
I try to let my shoulders drop.
A flock passes in the distance.
I hold my ki, waiting for it to fill.

lines.zh: 脚下画了个圈，我把土抹平。
lines.en: I trace a circle with my foot and smooth the soil.
I could really eat.

lines.zh: 手臂垂着，我一点也不紧张。
lines.en: Arms hanging, I'm not tense at all.
I wipe the sweat from my brow.
You don't look like you're from here.
I lift my head and meet your eyes.

lines.zh: 你身上没有气，是普通人。
lines.en: You carry no ki — an ordinary person.
I don't move; I wait for you to speak.
Your fists are closed — are we fighting?
My black hair covers half my face.
You speak first; then I decide.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢无缘无故打人。
lines.en: I don't like hitting people for no reason.
You're standing a little close.

lines.zh: 我朝你点点头，算是回应。
lines.en: I nod at you, which is my answer.
Your stance looks trained.
I don't smile this time.
I raise my hand, palm up.
No ill will — just caution.
Are you looking for me?
Teeth clenched, I take a step back.
That one landed solid.
Blood seeps from the corner of my mouth.
I wipe my face without a sound.
It hurts, but I can still move.
I steady my breathing.
The cut isn't deep; I can keep going.
I don't retreat; I stand and watch you.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来护住伤处。
lines.en: I turn to shield the wound.
Not bad. Come at me again.
This has a real smell to it.
My stomach spoke first.
Can I have half?
I take it carefully.

lines.zh: 三百万战力，先垫垫肚子。
lines.en: Three million power; let me eat first.
That's barely two bites.
You cook well.
I'll talk after I finish.
I eat fast.
I won't take it free; I'll work for it.
I hit you and stop at once.
You're several steps back — still standing?
Shoulder to shoulder; neither of us falls.
I tense up out of reflex.
I slip past on your flank.
You're sturdier than you look.

lines.zh: 我们再来一次，我让着点。
lines.en: Let's try again; I'll go easy.
Steady — no more knocking.

lines.zh: 我想起有人在等我回去。
lines.en: Someone's waiting for me to come home.

lines.zh: 我答应过要带东西回去。
lines.en: I promised to bring something back.

lines.zh: 战衣的口袋里还有半块干粮。
lines.en: Half a biscuit is still in my pocket.

lines.zh: 她要是知道我在这儿，准要骂。
lines.en: If she knew I was here, I'd get an earful.

lines.zh: 家这个概念，我一直记得。
lines.en: Home is something I've never forgotten.
I put my hand on my chest.
It's been a long time since I went back.
I have to come back alive.
That matters more than winning a fight.

lines.zh: 我抬头，把这事记在心里。
lines.en: I look up and file it away.
I pick up the cloth and inspect it.
I fold it and put it back.

lines.zh: 掉下来的果子，我擦了擦。
lines.en: The fallen fruit — I wipe it off.

lines.zh: 这东西很轻，风一吹就走。
lines.en: This is light; one gust takes it.
I weigh it; it has some heft.
I tie it to my belt.

lines.zh: 我看了半天，不明白做啥用。
lines.en: I study it a while and can't see the use.
It has a smell, so I sniff first.
I pick it up and hand it back to its owner.
I can only manage one thing.
Your ki stirred; so did mine.
I drop my hands and straighten up.
This one can't be avoided.
Feet planted; I'm ready.
Don't count on me swinging first.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，也看你的脚。
lines.en: I watch your hands and your feet.
You're planting your right foot too hard.

lines.zh: 我往前半步，气就压过去了。
lines.en: Half a step in and my ki presses forward.
There are only ten paces between us.
I lift my head and my eyes change.
Isn't your friend coming to help?
I'll give you the first one.
No speeches — I just come.
I turn with your steps.
You go right; I own the right.

lines.zh: 我留了一点距离，够我反应。
lines.en: I keep a little room, just enough to react.
You're hesitating; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我弓着身，随时能弹出去。
lines.en: Crouched, I can spring any moment.
I show you a gap on purpose.
You didn't take it, so I'll come instead.
The ki in my palm is enough.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就往前压半步。
lines.en: Each step you give, I take half of one more.
I step into your shadow.

lines.zh: 黑发垂到眼前，我拨了一下。
lines.en: Black hair hangs in my eyes; I push it aside.
I'm not yielding this step.

lines.zh: 你的拳会先来，然后才是腿。
lines.en: The punch comes first, then the kick.
I'm waiting for you to slip.
Ki circles in my palm.

lines.zh: 地面上的土被我的气推开。
lines.en: The dust is being pushed out by my ki.
One punch, square in the chest.
My sweeping kick sends you back.
My elbow drops and the ground breaks.
I take your wrist and twist.

lines.zh: 连出两拳，第二拳你没看到。
lines.en: Two punches — you never saw the second.
I pulled it; half strength only.
My knee comes up and you fold.

lines.zh: 我绕到背后，一掌推出去。
lines.en: I slip behind and shove with my palm.

lines.zh: 这一拳，我只用了三分力。
lines.en: That punch was only three-tenths of my strength.
I don't press on; I just stand.
My leg sweeps you down.
My fist wind grazes your cheek.
I land and press a dent into the earth.
Still standing — then here comes another.
Then here comes the next one.

lines.zh: 我从光里走出，脚下有风。
lines.en: I step out of the light with wind at my feet.
I land and my knees sink.
The grass all leans away from me.
I straighten and take a look around.
This isn't home.
I clench a fist; my ki is still there.
I dust off my clothes.
The sky overhead is unfamiliar.
I breathe in; the smell is wrong.
All around is quiet.
I take two steps; they're steady.
I cinch my belt.
Someone's watching from a distance.
I raise my head and let the wind pass.
I lower my stance and don't start trouble.
I need to get the lay of this land.

lines.zh: 火在身上爬，我一甩手扑开。
lines.en: Fire crawls on me; one shake of my hand clears it.
I slam into the earth, soil to my waist.
Water plugs my mouth and nose; I hold my breath.
The blast throws me a dozen paces.

lines.zh: 一支尖箭扎进我的手臂。
lines.en: A sharp arrow buries in my arm.

lines.zh: 有什么在我体内缠着我。
lines.en: Something's coiling inside me.
It's been too long since I ate.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我头发都直了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my hair stands straight.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我往下掉。
lines.en: There's nothing under me; I'm falling.
